rationale: The candidate reads as a compact split-box mass with a central seam, but the gesture is not yet convincingly tied to the neighborhood-living brief. In all views, the composition remains mostly two rectangular solids with a narrow interstitial gap; that gives some hierarchy, but the form is still boxy and only weakly sectional. The blue access edge is not answered by a clear public void, notch, or entry undercut; instead the street response feels sealed and semantically neutral. Because the mass does not develop a usable ground threshold or a meaningful section/public-space relationship, it fails the program hard pass despite acceptable geometric integrity. The form is coherent enough to survive as a solid, but not coherent enough as a neighborhood building section.
